brand_voice_note: Warm, witty and trade-savvy - it talks to business owners about restocking and margins while keeping the natural, no-nonsense sourcing plain and dog-loving.

concepts.primary_text:
A restless dog in the room is nobody's idea of a five-star stay.

Our Rabbit chews are a softer option for small, extra small, senior dogs and puppies - grain free, gluten free and easily-digestible for sensitive tummies. Perfect to keep our dogs occupied during our stay.

25 pre-packaged chews per box. Restock your dog menu and hand guests something that actually goes down a treat.
concepts.headline: Keep guest dogs happily busy
concepts.why_it_works: Softer rabbit chews solve a real friction for holiday lets and dog-friendly venues - occupying restless dogs - which speaks straight to the trade buyer.
concepts.visual_direction: The kraft rabbit-chew box standing upright with a single dried rabbit chew leaning against it, next to a small ceramic dog bowl on a warm oak surface.

concepts.primary_text:
Worried about what's really in that chew? Fair.

Our Boar chews are slow roasted and crunchy, air-dried using no additives or preservatives - just boar. A healthy alternative to rawhide, fully digestible and never containing rawhide.

Grain free, gluten free and medium-lasting, with 25 pre-packaged chews per box to restock your dog menu.
concepts.headline: A real alternative to rawhide
concepts.why_it_works: The biggest hesitation for a chew buyer is 'is this just processed rawhide?' - so we crush it head-on with the fully digestible, no-additives sourcing.
concepts.visual_direction: The kraft boar-chew box standing upright with the ridged boar chew bar leaning against it, beside a folded linen napkin and a fork on a pale stone surface.

concepts.primary_text:
From brew to biscuit - full circle. 🍺

We upcycle spent grain from the brewing process into these paw-shaped biscuits, made in the UK with all natural ingredients. Dog biscuits with a story worth telling.

A 5kg jar to restock your treat jar and upgrade your free dog-friendly offering with something guests remember.
concepts.headline: Dog biscuits with a story
concepts.why_it_works: Brewery Bites' upcycled-grain origin is a genuine talking point, so the founder story angle turns provenance into a reason for cafes and venues to stock them.
concepts.visual_direction: The glass clip-top jar full of paw-print biscuits on a rustic brewery counter with loose barley grains and a hand nearby, plus a few biscuits scattered in front.
